title: Hurricane Melissa Hit Jamaica at 185 Miles an Hour

scenes.text: Hurricane Melissa hit Jamaica with winds of 185 miles an hour.
It made landfall on October 28, 2025, as a Category 5.
That made it the strongest storm to hit Jamaica in 174 years of record keeping.
The National Hurricane Center called it one of the most powerful landfalls ever recorded in the Atlantic.
Forecasters expected up to forty inches of rain in places, more than three feet.
Winds of 185 miles an hour, the strongest Jamaica has on record.

description:
Hurricane Melissa made landfall in Jamaica on October 28, 2025, as a Category 5 with 185 mph winds.
It was the strongest storm to hit Jamaica in 174 years of records.
How would you prepare for a storm like this?
